schema:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  City,
  CustomerID,
  Email,
  First,
  FirstPurchaseDate,
  Gender,
  Last,
  PhoneNumber,
  State,
  StreetAddress,
  SubscribedToEmailList,
  ZipCode
);

CREATE TABLE location (
  City,
  LocationID,
  LocationName,
  State,
  StreetAddress,
  ZipCode
);

CREATE TABLE rootbeer (
  BrandID,
  ContainerType,
  LocationID,
  PurchaseDate,
  RootBeerID
);

CREATE TABLE rootbeerbrand (
  Alcoholic,
  ArtificialSweetener,
  AvailableInBottles,
  AvailableInCans,
  AvailableInKegs,
  BrandID,
  BrandName,
  BreweryName,
  Caffeinated,
  CaneSugar,
  City,
  CornSyrup,
  Country,
  CurrentRetailPrice,
  Description,
  FacebookPage,
  FirstBrewedYear,
  Honey,
  State,
  Twitter,
  Website,
  WholesaleCost
);

CREATE TABLE rootbeerreview (
  BrandID,
  CustomerID,
  Review,
  ReviewDate,
  StarRating
);

CREATE TABLE transaction (
  CreditCardNumber,
  CreditCardType,
  CustomerID,
  LocationID,
  PurchasePrice,
  RootBeerID,
  TransactionDate,
  TransactionID
);
